title: Not Everyone Wants to Read About Saint...So Here is A Video Instead.
subtitle: I'm saving you time.
body_html:
This is Owen Scott Muir, M.D. getting on the video train. I write a daily newsletter. You don't have to read it all. You can just about watch a video. It's all of one minute and 30 seconds. You're welcome.

Your time is valuable. This is concise information about the remarkable work done Acacia Clinics in Sunnyvale, California, and the care we will be bringing to Fermata in Brooklyn, NY soon.

The SAINT treatment is and FDA Cleared Breakthrough Treatment that gets Depression to Remission in 5 days in 79% of individuals in a published trial. It’s a spin out of the Stanford Brain Stimulation Lab. It’s fast! Like this video! The treatment is concluded for most people in 5 days.

Disclosure: I am a paid consultant to Magnus Medical, the SAINT patent holder, but I didn’t bill for this time, nor did they have input on the messaging in the video.

Here is the full length video—that is a minute longer than one of the SAINT treatment sessions—explaining accelerated TMS and its mechanisms on my YouTube channel that now exists: Your time is valuable. SAINT is rapid. This is only sort of clever, but take what you can get.
